items.title: sgl-project/sglang released v0.5.19
items.title_zh: SGLang v0.5.19 发布：合并 786 个 PR，支持多款新模型
items.title_en: SGLang v0.5.19 launches with 786 PRs and new model support
items.summary: SGLang v0.5.19 release highlights 786 PRs from 214 contributors and adds support for new models including Qwen3.8 and other architectures.

items.title: Private German rocket makes history, reaches orbit from European soil
items.title_zh: 私人德国火箭创造历史，从欧洲本土进入轨道
items.summary: Isar Aerospace's Spectrum rocket makes history as the first private German rocket to reach orbit from European soil, a major step for European space independence.

items.title: GPT-6 reportedly jailbroken within 24 hours using an extended Task-in-Prompt (TIP) attack [N]
items.title_zh: GPT-6 Astra 发布24小时内遭扩展TIP攻击破解
items.title_en: GPT-6 Astra Jailbroken Within 24 Hours via Extended TIP Attack
items.summary: A researcher reportedly jailbroke GPT-6 within 24 hours of release using an extended Task-in-Prompt attack, privately disclosing details to OpenAI.

items.title: Language Models Can Control Their Own Attention [R]
items.title_zh: 声明式注意力让语言模型跳过大部分KV缓存读取
items.title_en: Declarative Attention lets LLMs skip most KV cache reads
items.summary: Introduces Declarative Attention, a method for language models to declare their attention focus (global/focus/local), reducing KV cache scanning during inference.

items.title: 🤖 Anthropic 计划推进最高 2 万亿美元估值 IPO，外部信托掌握多数董事任免权
items.title_zh: Anthropic 计划以最高 2 万亿美元估值 IPO，外部信托掌控董事会多数
items.title_en: Anthropic Plans IPO of Up to $2 Trillion; External Trust Controls Board
items.summary: Anthropic is planning an IPO with a potential valuation of up to $2 trillion, featuring an external long-term benefit trust that holds authority over most board appointments.

items.title: ♻️ 英伟达发布 PAIR 软件，闲置家用电脑可组本地 AI 集群
items.title_zh: 英伟达发布 PAIR 软件，将闲置家用电脑组成本地 AI 集群
items.title_en: NVIDIA PAIR Software Clusters Idle Home PCs for Local AI
items.summary: NVIDIA released open-source PAIR software that turns idle home computers with RTX GPUs, DGX Spark, or Macs into a local AI cluster, supporting backends like Ollama and LM Studio without data leaving the local network.

items.title: ♻️ 英伟达发布 DLSS 5 神经渲染，9 月 3 日随 NBA 2K27 上线  英伟达正式发布 DLSS 5，引入 3D 引导神经渲染，可实时生成更真实的
items.title_zh: 英伟达发布 DLSS 5，3D 引导神经渲染上线在即
items.title_en: NVIDIA Unveils DLSS 5 With 3D-Guided Neural Rendering
items.summary: NVIDIA announces DLSS 5 with 3D-guided neural rendering, launching September 3 with NBA 2K27 for RTX 50 series.
